products.name: Krest Bitter Lemon Soda 1.25L
products.description: Krest Bitter Lemon Soft Drink is an adult soft drink that can be enjoyed on its own or as mixers with your favourite beverage. This is a zingy carbonated drink that can be enjoyed on its own or combined with alcohol or fruit juice. It is versatile, refreshing, full of flavour, and tasty. It is a great alternative to diet tonic water. It makes you feel refreshed and full of life. This bubbly water has sodium carbonate, it is a perfect balance between sweetness and bitter taste. It does not have any calories, no added sugar or artificial sweeteners.

products.name: Regular Coke 2L
products.description: The Coca-Cola PET 2L is a 2-liter plastic bottle packaging of the iconic Coca-Cola soft drink. The bottle is made from PET (polyethylene terephthalate), which is lightweight, durable, and recyclable. It features the classic red label with the white Coca-Cola logo, maintaining the brand's signature design. The bottle is ergonomically shaped for easy handling and pouring, with a screw-on cap that ensures a tight seal to maintain carbonation and freshness. This size is ideal for sharing in family gatherings, social events, or for storing in the refrigerator for individual servings over time.

products.name: The Glenlivet Whisky Founders Reserve 750ml 40%
Jameson Whiskey 350ml
products.description: Jameson Irish Whiskey is a blended Irish Whiskey. What's that we hear you say? Well first we take the best of pot still and fine grain whiskeys. Then we triple distill them- not because we have to because we want to as it gives it its signature smoothness. Finally we age them in oak casks for a minimum of 4 years. It’s where we recommend starting your whiskey journey. How to drink it? Any way you like. Just add mates and widen the circle. Triple distilled, twice as smooth, one of a kind.​
products.shortDescription: Jameson Irish Whiskey is a blended Irish Whiskey. What’s that we hear you say? Well first we take the best of pot still and fine grain whiskeys.
